# dsh-spend-pill
> A cost pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer status row — shows **what your previous turn actuall
pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer status row — shows **what your previous turn actually cost**.
Tiny DSH plugin. The pill reads `上句结算 ¥0.062`; click it for the breakdown: how many model calls that
turn took, how much was re-reading history, how heavy the context is, and what the next message's f
ixed "starting price" will be.
## Why
DSH's built-in stats row tells you `25 turns · 226 steps` and `11.1M tok · 99% cache hit`, but not *
lt-in stats row tells you `25 turns · 226 steps` and `11.1M tok · 99% cache hit`, but not **money**.
Two things about agent cost are counter-intuitive:
1. **You pay per model call, not per turn.** One turn can trigger ~10 calls (read a file, run a comm

and, edit code — each is a separate request), and every request re-bills the whole context.
2. **Re-
reading history is often the biggest line item.** At 390k tokens of context, each call re-reads 390k
tokens — more than the model actually spends thinking and writing.
This plugin puts both on screen.
## What it shows
**Pill (collapsed)**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Expanded**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Settled value, not an estimate**: the previous turn's cost is folded on the host from the full s

ession log, so it survives restarts and compaction.
- Thresholds: context turns amber at **50%**, re
d at **60%** — DSH auto-compacts around **69%**, so these leave headroom.
## Install
**From GitHub (recommended)**

Use `desktop` for the desktop app, `web` for the CLI web UI. Restart the host afterwards.
**Local development (clone + link)**

> ⚠️ **Do not install by npm package name yet.** The npm entry is a `0.0.0-stage`

behind by npm's staged-publishing flow and contains no `lib/`, so
> `dsh plugin add dsh-spend-pill`

## How it works
- **Host** (`lib/index.js`) registers a `spendStats` session projection. It consumes the provider-re
ported `usage` on `assistant/message`, splits turns on `turn/end`, and folds per-turn token totals.
Because the projection replays the **full persisted log**, restarts / pagination / compaction do not

change the result.
- **Client** (`lib/client.js`) registers into the `conversation.composer.dock` s

lot with `order: -1`, and reads the `tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`, and `spendStats` projections.
-
Pricing is hardcoded to **DeepSeek official rates** (cache hit 0.02, miss 1, output 4 CNY per milli

on tokens, off-peak; doubled at peak), with peak/off-peak detected from Beijing time.
- **Not an inv
oice**: the projection carries no per-call timestamps, so everything is converted at the *current* r
ate. Mixed peak/off-peak usage will drift.
## Limitations

- Prices only make sense for DeepSeek; edit `PRICE_PEAK` / `PRICE_OFF` for other providers.
- The se

ttled value is empty on the very first turn (`¥—`).
- An interrupted turn with no model calls does n
ot overwrite the last settled value.
